optimizeLiquidityAmounts(uint160,int24[].details: Optimizes liquidity amounts by widening up provided ticks using binary search + neighborhood search.

params.scan: True if binary and neighborhood ticks search for optimal liquidity is requested, false otherwise.

pickHiMaxUtil(int24,uint160,int24,uint25.details: Finds optimal ticks while fixing lower base tick.

params.lo: Raw lower tick candidate: MUST satisfy sqrtP > sqrt(lo).

pickLoMaxUtil(int24,uint160,int24,uint25.details: Finds optimal ticks while fixing upper base tick.

params.hi: upper tick candidate: MUST satisfy sqrtP < sqrt(hi).

devdoc.title: Neighborhood Scanner - Smart contract for scanning neighborhood ticks to better fit liquidity

optimizeLiquidityAmounts(uint160,int24[].notice: 1. Adjusts extreme boundaries, if required.         2. Looks for correct boundaries and adjusts tick spacings accordingly.         3. Fixes one of ticks and executed binary + neighborhood search if scan option is true. Ensures non-zero intermediate for amount0 formula without linear loops.

pickHiMaxUtil(int24,uint160,int24,uint25.notice: 1. Find ticks via a binary search such that the position consumes all available token0.         2. Minimally search around to find optimal ranges such that max amounts of token0 and token1 are used.

pickLoMaxUtil(int24,uint160,int24,uint25.notice: 1. Find ticks via a binary search such that the position consumes all available token1.         2. Minimally search around to find optimal ranges such that max amounts of token0 and token1 are used.
